# Freelance Dashboard

> Free freelancer dashboard that runs in your browser: see overdue invoices, unbilled hours, your estimate pipeline, year-to-date profit and tax set-aside, plus a ranked list of what to do next. No account, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
